summary: Unfold the energies and compare termwise: ‖a + b‖² ≤ (1 + ε)‖a‖² + (1 + ε⁻¹)‖b‖².

steps.claim: Unfolding energy(·, Ω) and collecting the right-hand side into one sum over c, c', s ∈ Ω, it suffices to compare the sums termwise: ‖A(c,s,c') + B(c,s,c')‖²/ν² against (1+ε)‖A(c,s,c')‖²/ν² + (1+ε⁻¹)‖B(c,s,c')‖²/ν².
Termwise (dividing by ν² is monotone): ‖a + b‖² ≤ (‖a‖ + ‖b‖)² = ‖a‖² + 2‖a‖‖b‖ + ‖b‖² ≤ ‖a‖² + ε‖a‖² + ε⁻¹‖b‖² + ‖b‖², using 2xy ≤ εx² + ε⁻¹y² for ε > 0 (hypothesis hε).
steps.lean: gcongr; grw [norm_add_le, add_sq, two_mul_le_add_mul_sq hε]; grind
